newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Bucharest bourse high in heavy first-tier trading.
newsitem.headline: Bucharest bourse high in heavy first-tier trading.

text.p: A special trade and cross deals in Bucharest first-tier stock Oltchim and heavy trading in first-tier Azomures raised bourse turnover to 2.7 billion lei on Thursday from a previous 2.02 billion.
Azomures SA fertiliser maker and chemical plant Oltchim SA jointly took 95 percent of turnover and both closed higher.
"The rest of the stocks seem completely unattractive at present, with everyone focusing on the two first-tier companies," a trader said.
The Bucharest bourse trades 23 stocks, 21 of them on the second tier. On Thursday, four stocks had no trade.

The Oltchim special trade -- a deal struck outside the market and reported to the bourse later -- involved 200,000 shares traded at 1,740 lei per share. The stock closed the session 20 lei stronger at 1,630.
Azomures had 985.2 million lei in turnover and gained 90 lei to close at 1,740.
Most other share prices inched higher due to low supply and two independent indices rose to year highs.
The unofficial indices VAB and BIG rose by 2.0 and 0.98 percent respectively from the previous session.
